children: Chemtrade says New PubCo’s authorized capital will consist solely of common shares at the proposed arrangement’s effective date; any future preferred-share class would require shareholder approval. Unitholders vote on the conversion on December 7, 2026.
New PubCo will have only common shares at closing
Removes the previously contemplated preferred-share authorization, limiting potential future financing flexibility unless shareholders approve an amendment.
The conversion from an income trust to a corporate structure remains subject to unitholder approval and other required approvals.
Arrangement needs at least 66 2/3% of votes cast
The supermajority threshold makes vote participation and support decisive for the proposed conversion.
Glass Lewis recommends voting FOR the arrangement
Proxy-adviser support may influence unitholder voting, alongside the board’s unanimous recommendation.

This is a supplemental update to Chemtrade’s previously announced proposed conversion from an income trust to a corporate structure, not a completed transaction. The next catalyst is the December 7, 2026 unitholder vote and subsequent required court and stock exchange approvals.
